recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed in FHIR core unless a future work group decision changes ServiceRequest.status modifier semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-5722 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Patient Care change request asking that ProcedureRequest.status be marked isModifier=true after review of status elements.
initial_application: The historical application is present in git history: commit fa99a64d6769d7911ee874527f4ee1a4615c29d9, matching Jira's svn revision 4842 comment, changed source/procedurerequest/procedurerequest-spreadsheet.xml so the ProcedureRequest.status Is Modifier column became Y.
additional_context: ProcedureRequest is no longer an active current-build resource. Current source/fhir.ini lists servicerequest=ServiceRequest as active and records ProcedureRequest as merged into ServiceRequest. The later GF#13867/FHIR-13867 source change renamed ProcedureRequest to ServiceRequest.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the active authoritative source, source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml, already marks ServiceRequest.status isModifier=true with an entered-in-error modifier reason.

related_jiras.note: Renamed/merged ProcedureRequest into ServiceRequest, establishing ServiceRequest.status as the current build-scope successor element checked for this audit.
